videos.title: What does it look like when your work takes you across the country? #Leadership
videos.description:
Based in Los Angeles, his projects are anything but local. From California to Virginia, New Jersey, Ohio, Michigan, Texas, and Nevada, the work continues to expand across different parts of the US.

With larger players entering the industry and new sites emerging, the opportunities are growing, and so is the reach of the projects he supports.

For him, there is another side to it too. Building a business across the country means getting to see more of it along the way.

#AMCOB #BusinessGrowth #Entrepreneurship #BusinessOwners #LosAngeles #BusinessOpportunities #Leadership

videos.title: Your accountant can get the numbers right. But is that enough to build a business that lasts? AMCOB
videos.description:
For Saleem, helping clients goes beyond taxes, books, and financial reports. The numbers matter, but without the right systems, processes, and operations behind them, long term success becomes much harder.

That is why his firm brings lessons from its own business into conversations with clients. The goal is not just to tell them what the numbers say, but to help them understand what needs to improve behind those numbers.

Because sometimes the biggest value an accounting firm can provide has nothing to do with filing a tax return. It is helping a business operate better.

#AMCOB #BusinessGrowth #Accounting #CPA #BusinessSystems #Entrepreneurship #FinancialClarity #BusinessOperations

videos.title: What changes when you stop being the person doing everything in your business? #BusinessSystems
videos.description:
For Saleem, building the right systems and processes meant he no longer had to work 60 or 70 hours every week. Other accounting firms started noticing the difference and asking what had changed. Soon, he was not only applying those systems to his own business, but teaching them to other firms as a coach.

That journey eventually helped him build a 25 person virtual CPA firm serving clients across the country.

But the bigger shift was moving beyond simply doing the books and filing tax returns. The focus became helping clients get real results through tax planning and greater financial clarity.

#AMCOB #BusinessGrowth #Accounting #CPA #Entrepreneurship #BusinessSystems #TaxPlanning #FinancialClarity

videos.title: Ever feel like your business cannot run without you? #BusinessMindset
videos.description:
That was the reality before one book completely changed the way he thought about business. After reading The E-Myth, he realized he was trying to wear three hats at once: the technician doing the work, the manager running the day to day, and the entrepreneur trying to build something bigger.

That realization led him to seek out Michael Gerber and hire him as a coach. The biggest lesson? Learning the difference between working in your business and working on your business.

When you are busy doing the accounting, handling taxes, and serving every client yourself, finding time to actually build the business can be the hardest part.

#AMCOB #Entrepreneurship #BusinessGrowth #EMyth #BusinessOwners #Leadership #BusinessMindset

videos.title: What if the goal of your business was to outlive you? #Entrepreneurship
videos.description:
Simon Sinek’s work has challenged many business owners to think beyond revenue and growth. Start With Why opened the conversation around purpose. His later work on the infinite mindset takes that thinking even further.

It raises a bigger question: are we building businesses only for the years we are here, or are we creating something that can continue serving people long after us?

For business owners, that shift changes the conversation from simply building a successful company to building something with purpose, longevity, and a legacy worth leaving behind.

#AMCOB #BusinessLegacy #SimonSinek #Entrepreneurship #BusinessOwners #Leadership #PurposeDrivenBusiness

videos.title: What happens when the business owner becomes the entire business? #Leadership
videos.description:
After reading The E-Myth, Kashi found himself facing a problem many entrepreneurs know too well. He was trying to be the technician, the manager, and the entrepreneur all at once. Accounting, taxes, clients, operations, everything depended on him.

That realization led him to seek out Michael Gerber, the founder of The E-Myth, and hire him as a coach. One idea changed the way he looked at business completely: stop spending all your time working in the business and start learning how to work on it.

It was a simple shift, but one that would change the way he built from that point forward.

#AMCOB #Entrepreneurship #BusinessGrowth #EMyth #BusinessOwners #Leadership #BusinessMindset

videos.title: What if your business could keep doing good 100 years after you are gone? #Entrepreneurship
videos.description:
For business owners, success does not always have to end with revenue, growth, or what we achieve in our own lifetime. A business can be built to serve people today while continuing to support meaningful causes for generations to come.

That is the kind of long term thinking AMCOB believes is worth having. Building businesses with purpose, creating opportunities for others, and surrounding yourself with a community that wants to see that impact grow.

Because the strongest legacy may not be the business you leave behind. It may be the good that business continues to do.

#AMCOB #BusinessLegacy #PurposeDrivenBusiness #BusinessOwners #Entrepreneurship #CommunityImpact #Leadership

videos.title: Do you really need hundreds of thousands of dollars to take your business global? #BusinessExpansion
videos.description:
Not necessarily. Depending on your goals, international opportunities can start with something as simple as incorporating a business or opening a bank account, while larger options may involve real estate, residency, or passport programs.

The key is that there is no one solution for everyone. Some clients want a second passport. Others simply need the right corporate or tax structure overseas.

So where do countries like Canada and Panama fit into the picture, and what could they offer someone looking to expand or relocate?

#AMCOB #GlobalBusiness #BusinessExpansion #InternationalBusiness #Panama #Canada #GlobalMobility

videos.title: Are the most popular global markets still the best places to invest? #GlobalMarkets
videos.description:
Hong Kong and Singapore have long been major players, but rising costs and heavier compliance are changing how some investors look at these markets.

The real opportunity may be in places that are not oversaturated yet. Panama, Portugal, Malta, Cyprus, and parts of Central and South America are gaining attention for their potential value, while the US remains firmly in the conversation.

Sometimes the smartest opportunity is not where everyone is already looking. It is where the value still has room to grow.

#AMCOB #GlobalInvestment #InvestmentOpportunities #Panama #GlobalMarkets #BusinessGrowth #Investing

videos.title: Rethinking Where to Incorporate #AMCOB
videos.description:
Right now, Canada isn't as conducive for business owners or investors. That's why we started there but have since shifted our focus to Panama. We previously helped clients in the GCC as well, places like Dubai and free zones, but because of current geopolitics, we're focusing on Panama for now. We can also help with incorporation in Hong Kong.

One major benefit of Panama is citizenship eligibility after five years, without having to actually live there. Similar to the Portugal Golden Visa, where an investment can qualify people for citizenship in 10 years without residing there. Panama offers the same, along with a territorial tax system, much like Hong Kong or the Marshall Islands. Anything earned outside the country, whether crypto or trading, isn't taxed, because it falls outside Panamanian borders.

That's the foundation for anyone looking to relocate.

#Panama #OffshoreIncorporation #TerritorialTax #Relocation #GlobalCitizen #AMCOB

videos.title: Where the Value Is Right Now #GlobalInvesting
videos.description:
There are new diamonds in the rough in Central and South America, places like Panama, alongside the US, which I'm still bullish on. I also like Portugal, Malta, and Cyprus because they're not oversaturated. A lot of markets have entry points or costs that are just too high.

I like value. If I were in the financial markets, I'd be looking for equities that offer real value, and that's exactly how I think about these countries too.

From an immigration perspective, Americans tend to gravitate toward the Mediterranean, though they're usually not chasing a second passport as much. Canadians, on the other hand, are looking for something more tax friendly, with good weather and good safety.
